{{CharInfobox |color={{sun color}} |corecolor={{sun color light}} |bordercolor={{sun color dark}} |name=Danika |jname=アサヒ |tmname=Asahi |image=Danika JN.png |size=150px |caption=Danika in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'' |age=no |colors=no |eyes=Blue |hair=Teal |gender=Female |trainer=yes |trainerclass=[[Pokémon Trainer]] |team=yes |teamname=[[Project Mew]] |teamrank=Chaser |anime=yes |epnum=JN068 |epname=Advice to Goh! |enva=[[Anjali Kunapaneni]] |java=[[Ryoko Shiraishi]] }} '''Danika''' (Japanese: '''アサヒ''' ''Asahi'') is a recurring character in ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''. She is a {{pkmn|Trainer}} and researcher with [[Project Mew]]. ==In animation== ===History=== Danika first appeared in ''[[JN068|Advice to Goh!]]'', when she contacted {{Gary}} on his [[Rotom Phone]] after receiving the feather of {{p|Moltres}} and awarded him a token with a {{p|Mew}} symbol. She made her first in-person appearance in ''[[JN071|Leaping Toward the Dream!]]'', where she explained to {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] how Project Mew operates, and gave Goh his mission of {{pkmn2|caught|catching}} an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Ninetales}} on [[Mount Coronet]]. After Goh had succeeded in the mission, Danika congratulated him on his success and informed him that he was now qualified to start taking on proper [[Field Research|Trial Missions]]. Danika reappeared in ''[[JN080|Trial on a Golden Scale!]]''. She was first seen monitoring Ninetales after returning it to its natural habitat. Shortly thereafter she discussed with [[Quillon]] about Goh's future in Project Mew. Later, when Goh and Ash were surrounded by [[Pokémon hunter]] [[Nito]] and his henchmen, Danika intervened and saved them using her {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Urshifu|Rapid Strike Style}} {{p|Urshifu}}. Once everything was resolved, Danika handed Goh his first Project Mew Token and encouraged him to continue giving his best. In ''[[JN088|Looking Out for Number Two!]]'', Danika received a message from Goh, informing her that he had completed his second Trial Mission. She sent him a token before joining Quillon in facing a {{p|Regirock}} as it emerged from the ruins before them. In ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]'', Danika, along with Quillon, was seen evaluating the performance of [[Goh]], {{Gary}}, and [[Horace]]'s [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against an {{p|Articuno}}. Danika personally monitored the [[Sea Mauville]] battle royale in ''[[JN110|Narrowing the Chaser Chase!]]''. After informing the rules to the participating Challengers, at a certain point in the mission she released some Pokémon as obstacles to make the mission difficult. When Horace becomes the winner of the mission, Danika and Quillon passed the results of the participants of that moment and warned that the period for evaluation was about to end. In ''[[JN113|Chasing to the Finish!]]'', Danika supervised one of the last Trial Missions, which was won by Horace. After the mission was completed, she joined Quillon at the [[Split-Decision Ruins]] to see the conclusion of the other last mission, which Goh and Gary successfully cleared. In ''[[JN129|A Flood of Torrential Gains!]]'', Danika met with the other members of Project Mew in [[Slateport City]] to begin the final expedition. In ''[[JN133|The Mew from Here!]]'' and ''[[JN134|In the Palms of our Hands!]]'', Danika and the other members of Project Mew explored [[Faraway Island]] in their search for {{an|Mew}}, eventually succeeding in finding it. After this, Project Mew was disbanded. In [[JN136]], Danika was seen holding a {{p|Cubchoo}} whilst Quillon was healing a {{p|Beartic}} that was injured. This scene was {{DL|JN136|Dub edits|not included}} in the episode's English [[dub]]bed version. ===Character=== Unlike [[Quillon]], Danika is far more welcoming and friendly, encouraging [[Goh]] to give his best. However, she also has a subtle harsh streak to her, seen when she forced Goh and Horace to battle each other to determine the winner of the Sea Mauville Trial Mission. In battle, her most friendly posture is left aside in favor of calm confidence, even choosing several opponents for battle and disqualifying the [[Pokémon hunters]] as soon as she arrived at the place. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|2|java|enva|scope=section}} ====On hand==== This listing is of Danika's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Danika |pkmn=Azumarill |type1=Water |type2=Fairy |img=Danika Azumarill.png |epnum=JN080 |epname=Trial on a Golden Scale! |vajp=Risa Shimizu |vaen=Cherami Leigh |desc={{p|Azumarill}} is Danika's first known Pokémon and it's usually seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside of its Poké Ball]]. Later, when Goh completed his first Trial Mission, Azumarill appeared alongside Danika, encouraging Goh.
